description: Export published post performance metrics (likes, comments, shares, views and reach) as formula-safe RFC 4180 CSV (Studio and Pro). Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: How many past days to include (1 to 365). Defaults to 30.

locationId.description: Optional location id from locations_list to filter exported results to one location.

source.description: Which posts to export: "all" (Spica + synced native posts, default), "spica", or "native".

name: export_results
title: Export results CSV
